title: Rename Semio Server to Semio Hub
description: Rename the semio server technology/module to semio hub across the semio/ codebase. The hub directory already exists (Cargo.toml, bin.rs, compose.yml, k8s.yaml); the old semio/server directory is empty. Update all references (paths, identifiers, comments, configs) in semio/ to use "hub" instead of "server" where they refer to the semio server subsystem. Do not touch repo/ (different technology). Remove the stale empty semio/server directory at the end.
summary: Renamed the semio server subsystem to semio hub across the semio/ technology. Cargo package & binary renamed from "semio-session" to "semio-hub" (semio/hub/Cargo.toml). Compose (semio/hub/compose.yml): service key session→hub, working_dir /workspace/semio/server→/workspace/semio/hub, DB name semio_session→semio_hub, RUST_LOG filter semio_session→semio_hub, region 🔖Session→🔖Hub. K8s (semio/hub/k8s.yaml): namespace, all metadata names, selectors, labels, image, env and log filters renamed session/semio-session→hub/semio-hub; SessionService/SessionDeployment regions renamed to HubService/HubDeployment; ingress backend session→hub. bin.rs (semio/hub/bin.rs): admin summary comment, startup log tag, default EnvFilter and default DATABASE_URL all semio_session/semio-session→semio_hub/semio-hub. .vscode/launch.json: launcher name 🛠️dev👤semio📚server→🛠️dev👤semio📚hub and `cargo run -p semio-session`→`cargo run -p semio-hub`. User-facing strings and specs in semio/sketchpad/index.tsx, semio/engine/main.py, semio/js/index.ts, semio/desktop/renderer.tsx, semio/DOCS.md: "semio server" / "semio/server" / "semio-session" → "semio hub" / "semio/hub" / "semio-hub". Removed the now-empty semio/server directory. repo/ (different technology; SEMIO_SERVER_* env vars and repo/server belong to the repo server) was intentionally not touched.
